# Rules

1. Each Hugging Face account competes as one team. Do not submit from more than one account.
2. Any method is allowed, including machine learning models, AI agents and external data.
3. There is no daily submission limit to work around: submit as often as you like.
4. Only your latest scored submission counts for the final standings. Earlier submissions don't count, even if they scored better, and selecting submissions on the My submissions page has no effect.
5. Submissions close on December 10, 2026, 23:59 UTC. Final standings come from the private leaderboard after the Round 3 originality markets on deep.seer.pm resolve and every submission is re-scored.
6. Prizes: $1,000 for 1st place, $650 for 2nd and $350 for 3rd, among eligible teams.
7. To be eligible for a prize, a team must have made a trade of at least $10 in sUSDS on the Round 3 originality markets on Seer (deep.seer.pm). The organizers manually verify the trades of the top 3 submissions only. A top-3 submission without that trade does not count, and the next eligible team moves up.
8. The organizers may disqualify a submission or account that abuses the evaluation system.
